question: On which of the following dates was Hindi adopted as the official language of the Indian Union?
solution:
The correct answer is __**14 September 1949**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hindi** was declared the official language of the Union of India on **September 14, 1949**. There is no national language in India.
